about: The Municipality of the District of Lunenburg is a municipal district on Nova Scotia’s South Shore, surrounding—but not including—the separate Town of Lunenburg and Town of Mahone Bay. It covers coastal communities, inland lakes, and forested countryside across a wide rural territory. Fishing harbours, cottage shores, and highway villages define daily life. About 26,000 people live in the District of Lunenburg.
